Body.Content:
To support Spain's upcoming mandatory B2B electronic invoicing requirements under the Crea y Crece legislation, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance will introduce capabilities for domestic B2B electronic invoicing through a phased rollout.

The planned rollout includes:

Prerequisite data and invoice formats: Support the required master, reference, and configuration data, together with Spain-specific UBL 2.5 electronic invoice formats for outbound and inbound invoices.

Invoice lifecycle management: Introduce capabilities for handling invoice status messages, acknowledgements, rejections, and payment reporting. Delivery timeline to be confirmed.

Electronic invoicing connectivity: Enable integration with the applicable electronic invoicing infrastructure. The integration approach and delivery timeline are being evaluated and will be confirmed later.

The scope and delivery timelines will be updated as implementation progresses and regulatory requirements are finalized.

GA date: May CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
